performanceCriteria.description: Communicate with the supervisor to understand the day's production requirements and plan work.
Apply approved drawings, job instructions or work manuals.
Collect required consumables, including wires and connectors.
Collect the work manual or job instruction from the manager.
Visually inspect boards and components for physical damage, loose connections or incorrect connections.
Follow the standard operating procedure to assemble the electrical subsystem.
Accurately interpret drawings, wiring and job specifications or instructions.
Identify and mark errors found in a previous assembly step.
Report defective components or an inadequate number of components.
Report insufficient consumables, such as wires, connectors, screws and nuts.
Test installations before energizing, including insulation resistance, earth continuity, polarity and visual inspection, to support personal and electrical safety.
Test energized installations for correct operation, including voltage, phase rotation and protection-device functioning.
Set up equipment and configure programmable relays, bus systems, timers and overload relays; load required applications and configure systems such as KNX, DALI, Modbus and IP- or IT-based systems.
Set the installation to full working condition and ensure the customer can operate it.
Adapt to changing circumstances.

Troubleshoot installation faults, including short or open circuits, incorrect polarity, insulation-resistance or earth-continuity faults, incorrect equipment settings and incorrect programmable-device settings.
Diagnose installation problems, including bad connections, incorrect wiring, high loop impedance and equipment failure.
Verify that an existing electrical installation continues to meet applicable current standards.
Use, test and calibrate measuring equipment, including insulation-resistance, continuity, installation, multimeter, clamp and network-cable testers.
Repair or replace faulty components in electrical installations.
Rewire and repair faulty installations.
Identify employability skills required for jobs across industries.
Identify and explore learning and employability portals.
Recognize constitutional values, civic rights and duties, citizenship, social responsibility, and personal ethics.
Follow environmentally sustainable practices.
Recognize the importance of 21st-century skills for employment.
Practise self-awareness, behaviour skills, time management, critical and adaptive thinking, problem-solving, creativity, social and cultural awareness, emotional awareness and continuous learning.
Use basic English in everyday conversations, in person and over the telephone.
Read and understand routine information and instructions written in English.
Write short messages, notes, letters and emails in English.
Understand the difference between a job and a career.
Prepare a career development plan with short- and long-term goals based on aptitude.
Follow verbal and non-verbal communication etiquette and active-listening techniques.
Work collaboratively with others in a team.
Communicate and behave appropriately with people of all genders and persons with disabilities.
Escalate workplace sexual-harassment issues according to the POSH Act.
Select financial institutions, products and services according to requirements.
Carry out offline and online financial transactions safely and securely.
Identify salary components and calculate income, expenses, taxes and investments.
Identify relevant rights and laws and use legal aid to address legal exploitation.
Operate digital devices and perform basic internet operations securely.
Use email, social media and virtual collaboration tools effectively.
Use basic features of word-processing, spreadsheet and presentation software.
Identify types of entrepreneurship and enterprises and research potential business opportunities.
Develop a business plan and work model using the 4Ps: Product, Price, Place and Promotion.
Identify funding sources and anticipate or mitigate financial and legal barriers to a business opportunity.
Identify different types of customers.
Identify and respond professionally to customer requests and needs.
Follow appropriate hygiene and grooming standards.
Create a professional curriculum vitae or résumé.
Search for suitable jobs using reliable offline and online sources.
Apply for identified job openings using suitable offline or online methods.
Answer recruitment and selection questions politely, clearly and confidently.
Identify apprenticeship opportunities and register according to applicable guidelines and requirements.
Identify workplace hazards and possible causes of accidents.
Follow organizational safe-working practices and observe hazard signs in work areas.
Use appropriate personal protective equipment for the task, working conditions and hazard severity.
Follow safety procedures when handling tools, equipment and hazardous substances or working in hazardous environments.
Dispose of electronic waste using industry-approved techniques.
Prevent component damage by following electrostatic-discharge procedures.
Locate workplace health and safety equipment, including fire extinguishers, first-aid equipment, safety equipment and fire exits.
Maintain appropriate posture when handling heavy objects.
Apply good housekeeping practices.
Take preventive measures to avoid fire hazards.
Use appropriate fire extinguishers for different types of fires.
Demonstrate rescue and first-aid techniques in cases of fire or electrocution.
Provide appropriate first aid for bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock and poisoning.
Provide first aid in cases of heart attack or cardiac arrest due to electric shock.
Follow emergency procedures, including raising alarms, evacuation, taking shelter, reaching assembly points, roll call and safe return to work.
Use the correct method to move injured people during an emergency.
Identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste.
Segregate waste into appropriate categories.
Ensure appropriate disposal of non-recyclable waste.
Deposit materials for disposal or reuse at identified locations, as described in the qualification file.
Follow specified processes for hazardous-waste disposal.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you check before starting an electrical installation task?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Review the job instructions and approved drawings, collect the required materials, inspect components for visible damage, and identify relevant workplace hazards.

vivaQuestions.question: Why must you follow approved drawings and job instructions?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: They provide the specifications and instructions needed to carry out the assigned work correctly and consistently.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if you find a damaged electrical component?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Do not use it without appropriate evaluation. Report the defect to the responsible person and follow the applicable workplace procedure.

vivaQuestions.question: What checks are required before an electrical installation is energized?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: The qualification lists insulation-resistance testing, earth-continuity testing, polarity checks and visual inspection before energizing.

vivaQuestions.question: What types of checks may be performed on an energized installation?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: The qualification lists functionality, voltage, phase rotation and protection-device checks. These must be performed only by an authorized, competent person using appropriate safety procedures.

vivaQuestions.question: What is troubleshooting in an electrical installation?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: It is the process of investigating a fault, identifying its likely cause and determining an appropriate corrective action.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if you discover incorrect wiring or a bad connection?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Follow the applicable isolation and safety procedure, investigate the fault within your competence, and repair or report it according to workplace requirements.

vivaQuestions.question: Name some hazards that may be present at an electrical worksite.
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Possible hazards include electric shock, damaged equipment, exposed conductors, fire risks, unsafe tools and unsuitable working conditions.

vivaQuestions.question: Why is personal protective equipment important?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Appropriate PPE helps reduce exposure to workplace hazards when selected and used correctly alongside other required safety controls.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do when you encounter an emergency at work?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Follow workplace emergency and evacuation procedures, alert the appropriate people, and provide only the first aid or assistance for which you are trained.

vivaQuestions.question: Why should measuring instruments be suitable for the test being performed?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: The qualification requires appropriate measuring equipment to be used, tested and calibrated for relevant installation checks.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if a test result indicates a possible electrical fault?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Follow the applicable safety procedure, investigate the result within your competence, and report or correct the fault according to workplace requirements.

vivaQuestions.question: Why is earth continuity testing important?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: It checks continuity of the protective earthing path as part of the required electrical installation tests.

vivaQuestions.question: What is the purpose of an insulation-resistance test?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: It assesses the insulation resistance of an electrical installation using a suitable tester and the applicable safe testing procedure.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if the required materials or consumables are insufficient?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Report the shortage to the responsible person so the required materials can be arranged before the work proceeds.

vivaQuestions.question: Why should electrical components be visually inspected before assembly?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Visual inspection can identify damage, loose connections or incorrect connections before assembly continues.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if you identify an error in an earlier assembly step?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Identify and report the error to the responsible person and follow the approved procedure for correcting it.

vivaQuestions.question: Why is housekeeping important in an electrical workplace?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Good housekeeping helps maintain an orderly work area and supports safer work practices.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you consider when handling heavy objects at work?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Follow safe handling practices and appropriate posture guidance to reduce the risk of injury.

vivaQuestions.question: Why must electrical and electronic waste be handled appropriately?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: The qualification requires workers to identify and segregate waste and follow the appropriate disposal procedures for relevant waste categories.

vivaQuestions.question: Why should a worker follow workplace safety signs and instructions?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: They communicate relevant hazards, precautions and required actions for the work area.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if you find a fire hazard at the workplace?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Follow workplace safety procedures, report the hazard and take only those actions that are safe and within your training.

vivaQuestions.question: Why is it important to know the location of first-aid equipment and emergency exits?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Knowing their locations helps workers respond more effectively during an emergency.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if a person receives an electric shock?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Do not touch the person while they may still be in contact with an electrical source. Raise the alarm, arrange emergency assistance and follow the appropriate trained rescue and first-aid procedures.

vivaQuestions.question: Why must the correct type of fire extinguisher be selected?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: The qualification requires workers to identify fire types and select appropriate extinguishers. The choice must follow site procedures and applicable fire-safety guidance.

vivaQuestions.question: Why should a worker communicate a problem to the supervisor?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Communication helps the responsible person understand the issue and coordinate an appropriate response to the work requirement.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do when workplace instructions or circumstances change?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Adapt appropriately, confirm unclear instructions with the responsible person and continue to follow applicable safety requirements.

vivaQuestions.question: Why are digital skills useful in the workplace?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Digital skills can support workplace communication, access to information and completion of relevant work-related tasks.

vivaQuestions.question: Why should a worker keep learning and improving their skills?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Continued learning supports skill development, adaptation to changing work requirements and career progression.

vivaQuestions.question: What should you do if you are asked to perform a task beyond your competence or authorization?
vivaQuestions.expectedFocus: Explain the limitation to the responsible person and seek appropriate supervision, training or an authorized competent worker rather than proceeding unsafely.

practicalAssessmentTasks.task_name: Interpret job instructions and plan work

Identifies required materials and consumables
Identifies visible defects or missing components
Reports unclear instructions or shortages
safety_controls: Use a simulated work order or de-energized training setup
Do not proceed when instructions are unclear

criteria: Performs a visual inspection
Identifies visible damage or loose connections
Reports defective or inadequate components
Follows the provided inspection instructions
safety_controls: Do not handle damaged energized equipment

practicalAssessmentTasks.task_name: Demonstrate an installation or assembly sequence
criteria: Follows the supplied job instructions
Selects the specified components and consumables
Follows the approved assembly sequence
Identifies and reports a simulated assembly error
safety_controls: Use a training board or approved de-energized setup
Qualified assessor must approve the task setup

criteria: Identifies the required tests from the task instructions
Selects appropriate test equipment
Explains the applicable safe testing sequence
Records or reports the observed test results
safety_controls: Use a simulator or approved de-energized training rig
Any physical testing must follow qualified supervision and approved procedures

criteria: Gathers the information needed to investigate the fault
Identifies a plausible cause from the supplied evidence
Explains the appropriate corrective action
Documents or reports the findings
safety_controls: Use a fault simulator or de-energized training equipment
Do not introduce real electrical hazards to create a fault

practicalAssessmentTasks.task_name: Identify workplace hazards and safety controls
criteria: Identifies hazards in the supplied work scenario
Selects relevant safety precautions
Identifies appropriate PPE and safety equipment
Explains when work must stop and the hazard must be reported
safety_controls: No real hazardous exposure is required

practicalAssessmentTasks.task_name: Respond to a simulated workplace emergency
criteria: Identifies the appropriate emergency procedure
Explains how to raise the alarm and obtain help
Identifies the need to avoid unsafe contact with electrical hazards
Explains the limits of their first-aid training
safety_controls: Use role-play or a simulated scenario
Do not use a real electrical incident or unsafe live demonstration

criteria: Communicates task information clearly
Reports a simulated defect or shortage
Responds appropriately to a clarification request
Records relevant information in the supplied format
